models.name: DFN
models.implementation: public-reference geometry plus explicitly generated stress-weighted orientation proposals
models.evaluation: No field fracture truth; prediction accuracy unavailable.

models.name: EDFM two-phase compact reproduction
models.implementation: 2D incompressible oil/water; explicit matrix/fracture pressure unknowns; matrix-fracture transfer and along/intersection fracture transmissibility; sequential pressure + implicit conservative upwind Corey transport

source.matrix_heterogeneity: public SPE9 PERMX layer1 mapped to 12x10 and rescaled to scenario median80mD
source.original_coordinate_policy: public model-coordinate extents are interpreted as700x600metres for this generated scenario; not georeferenced field coordinates

assumptions: Two incompressible immiscible phases; no gas, gravity, capillarity, compressibility, thermal or mechanics solve.
Pressure-driven water injection on left and fixed-pressure withdrawal on right; all other external boundaries no-flow.
Each clipped public line piece is a distinct fracture pressure/storage DOF coupled to its host matrix cell.
Uniform assumed fracture aperture per case; cubic-law kf=b^2/12; no measured fracture hydraulic calibration.
Fracture intersections connected geometrically; matrix-fracture transfer uses a documented centroid-distance shape-factor approximation.
Matrix porosity0.2, thickness10m and fluid/relative-permeability parameters are scenario assumptions.
Sequential pressure/transport coupling is a simplified EDFM reproduction, not an industry-certified simulator.
Generated stress-weighted DFN proposals are not inversion or validated fracture predictions.

dataset_split.purpose: examples for model adapters or future surrogate training; simulator itself is not trained
dataset_split.limitations: Only six parameter combinations; all share public geometry/heterogeneity. Test is an aperture/pressure scenario, not independent geological generalization.

crm_controlled_benchmark.scope: two injector signals, one producer response, fixed response and independent declining contribution; not spatial field connectivity proof
